notes.title: Move modifiers and 100 wishlist update!
notes.notes:
Long time no see!

We got 100+ wishlists on Steam and wanted to thank everyone for the support!

https://i.imgur.com/BUiVJLQ.png
(art thanks by @sorixasorinai on X and bsky)

We have a lot to share along with this, between things like move modifiers in battle - sometimes, when you receive a card, it might come with a move modifier that will change how the move works entirely along with its effects, damage and turn order.

For instance, here we have a Winding move waiting for the next turn.

https://i.imgur.com/YuorT4i.png

In this case, Lavinia gives up her current turn to do more than double the damage her next turn. The regular move is just a basic attack that deals light damage, but now that it's got the Winding modifier, it's a heavy hitter. Modifiers can be added to already existing cards at this angry blacksmith.

https://i.imgur.com/sEftjMh.png

Also, we're aiming to get a public demo by the end of the year and if not then, by the end of January. Thanks for sticking around and let us know if you have any questions! Please remember that everything here is in development and subject to change.

-Niko
